title: PIM for Active Directory: remove the hybrid worker (Azure VM or Azure Arc server)
purpose: Removes the PIM for Active Directory hybrid worker and everything PIM's worker scripts created for it, and prints the Active Directory clean-up for the AD administrator.
whenToRun: When you retire a hybrid worker. Run it without -Apply first: it lists what it would delete and what it keeps. -Target Azure for the worker VM New-PimHybridWorkerInfra.ps1 built; -Target Arc for an on-premises Azure Arc server (the server itself is never removed). -StatePath reads the values Deploy-PimHybridWorker.ps1 remembered.

runAs.name: Contributor
runAs.why: deletes the VM, its NIC and disk, the VNet, NAT gateway, public IP, NSG and the empty resource group

runAs.name: Network Contributor
runAs.scope: every VNet the worker was peered with; the private DNS zone (with -PrivateSqlDnsZoneId)
runAs.why: deletes the remote-side peerings PIM created and the zone's link to the worker VNet

runAs.name: SQL Server Contributor
runAs.why: deletes the VNet rule 'pimhybridwrk' (Azure VM) or the firewall rules 'pimhybridwrk-arc-<server>-<n>' (Arc)

runAs.name: User Access Administrator
runAs.why: deletes the worker identity's Storage Blob Data Reader assignment

runAs.name: Privileged Role Administrator
runAs.why: deletes the worker identity's Microsoft Graph application permission grants (appRoleAssignments)

runAs.name: member of the PIM SQL admin group
runAs.why: DROP USER of the worker's contained database user

runAs.name: Azure Connected Machine Resource Administrator
runAs.why: runs Install-PimHybridWorker.ps1 -Phase Remove on the server through run-command

changes.object: the application permission grants Grant-PimHybridWorkerAccess.ps1 gives: Group.Read.All, User.Read.All, PrivilegedAssignmentSchedule.Read.AzureADGroup, Mail.Send (when granted)
changes.why: the worker no longer reads the directory

changes.object: Storage Blob Data Reader of the worker identity
changes.why: the worker no longer fetches PIM code

changes.object: the contained user -SqlUserName (database user), only when it carries the worker identity's SID
changes.why: no database access is left behind

changes.object: VNet rule 'pimhybridwrk' (only when it names the worker subnet) / firewall rules 'pimhybridwrk-arc-<server>-<n>'
the zone's link to the worker VNet; links to other VNets and the zone itself are kept and listed

the remote-side peerings '<remote>-to-pimhybridwrk' and the worker-side peerings, the VM with its NIC and OS disk, the VNet, the NAT gateway and its public IP, the NSG, and the resource group when PIM created it and it is empty -- only resources tagged pim-hybrid-worker=<worker> (or, with -IncludeUntagged, carrying exactly the scripts' name)
changes.why: the worker is retired; nothing PIM did not create is touched
changes.undo: Deploy-PimHybridWorker.ps1 (a new worker; the VM's identity is new, so the grants are re-run)

changes.object: the worker's six scheduled tasks, its gMSAs' membership of 'Hybrid agent extension applications' and 'log on as a batch job', C:\PIM\app and C:\PIM\bin (logs kept) -- the machine, its agent and identity stay

parameters.name: SubscriptionId
parameters.help: The worker's subscription (Azure VM) or the Arc machine's.

parameters.name: TenantId
parameters.help: The tenant; the script refuses a subscription in another one.

parameters.name: Target
parameters.help: Azure (the worker VM) or Arc (an on-premises Azure Arc server). Read from -StatePath when given there.

parameters.name: ResourceGroup
parameters.help: Azure: the worker's resource group.

parameters.name: VmName
parameters.help: Azure: the worker VM (the tag value pim-hybrid-worker).

parameters.name: VnetName
parameters.help: Azure: the worker VNet.

parameters.name: NatGatewayName
parameters.help: Azure: the NAT gateway Set-PimHybridWorkerEgress.ps1 created.

parameters.name: PublicIpName
parameters.help: Azure: the NAT gateway's public IP.

parameters.name: PrivateSqlDnsZoneId
parameters.help: The privatelink.database.windows.net zone the build linked; its link to the worker VNet is deleted.

parameters.name: IncludeUntagged
parameters.help: A worker built before the tags: also accept untagged resources carrying exactly the scripts' names in -ResourceGroup. Check the plan first.

parameters.name: ArcMachineResourceId
parameters.help: Arc: the machine's resource id (required for -Target Arc). The machine is never removed.

parameters.name: ArcApiVersion
parameters.help: Microsoft.HybridCompute api-version.

parameters.name: PrintOnly
parameters.help: Arc: write the self-contained removal script for the server's administrator instead of using run-command.

parameters.name: SqlServerId
parameters.help: The PIM SQL server: its worker rules and the contained user are removed.

parameters.name: SqlDatabase
parameters.help: The PIM database.

parameters.name: SqlUserName
parameters.help: The worker's contained user.

parameters.name: KeepSqlUser
parameters.help: Leave the database user in place.

parameters.name: SourceContainerId
parameters.help: The source container whose Storage Blob Data Reader assignment is removed.

parameters.name: AdDomain
parameters.help: AD (printed only): the NetBIOS domain name.

parameters.name: GmsaName
parameters.help: AD (printed only): the worker gMSA.

parameters.name: GmsaOu
parameters.help: AD (printed only): the OU holding the gMSAs and their groups.

parameters.name: ServerGmsaName
parameters.help: AD (printed only): the server-onboarding gMSA, when used.

parameters.name: ServerOu
parameters.help: AD (printed only): the OUs the servers GPO is linked to.

parameters.name: ServerAdminGpoName
parameters.default: PIM for AD: <ServerGmsaName>-PermissionGroup is local administrator (servers)
parameters.help: AD (printed only): the servers GPO's name.

parameters.name: ComputerOu
parameters.help: AD (printed only): the OU of the worker VM's computer account.

parameters.name: GroupsOu
parameters.help: AD (printed only): the OU where the PermissionGroup holds rights.

parameters.name: AdminAccountsOu
parameters.help: AD (printed only): the admin-account OUs where the PermissionGroup holds rights.

parameters.name: GrantProtectedGroupMembership
parameters.help: AD (printed only): the worker was given the AdminSDHolder right.

parameters.name: StatePath
parameters.help: A Deploy-PimHybridWorker.ps1 state file: every value not given is read from it.

parameters.name: Apply
parameters.help: Delete. Without it the script only prints the plan.

parameters.name: PollSeconds
parameters.help: How often a delete is checked until the resource is gone.

readsOnly: the worker VM / Arc machine and its identity
the identity's Graph grants and role assignments
the NAT gateway, public IP, NSG and resource group with their tags
network: management.azure.com (ARM REST), graph.microsoft.com, the PIM SQL server on 1433 (DROP USER), and login.microsoftonline.com -- browser sign-in or an Invardia support session; no Azure CLI, no PowerShell module
whatIf: Without -Apply (or with -WhatIf) it prints every object it would delete, every object it keeps and why, and the Active Directory clean-up; changes nothing.
undo: Nothing deleted can be restored by this script: build the worker again with Deploy-PimHybridWorker.ps1 (a new VM identity, so the grants are given again). Active Directory is never changed by it.
